title: C# and .NET
text: My main language since 2022. ASP.NET Core and MVC, background jobs, document generation, and a lot of legacy .NET Framework kept alive and moved forward.

title: Azure
text: Virtual machines, App Service, networking, backups and recovery. I have moved complete production environments into Azure and run them since.

title: SQL Server
text: Schema design, migrations, stored procedures, performance work and the data imports that feed business systems every day.

title: Azure DevOps, Bicep, Docker
text: Repos, pipelines and infrastructure as code, so environments are reproducible and deployments are not a person clicking through a server.

title: React, Angular, TypeScript
text: Front-ends for business applications and for my own products: React 19 with TanStack, Angular where the project already uses it, TypeScript everywhere.

title: Integrations and APIs
text: REST APIs, partner and B2B integrations, electronic document exchange and customs interfaces. The unglamorous part that makes systems talk to each other.

title: Supabase and Postgres
text: For my own products: Postgres functions and row-level security as the business logic, Supabase Auth, and a small, fast stack around it.
